⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **p2:** the relay's `pr_create` asks the governed approvers to review a Tier H draft before any contract review exists (maintainer: 「关键是还没有契约复审,你就推送给我审核了,这个是skills 的问题」). The likely shape: the review request waits until a same-head contract review PASS is recorded.
- **`pm:on-hold`, not `pm:queue`:** the maintainer said 「只开卡,不要派发」.

Restart-when: the maintainer says to dispatch it.

## Recurrence readings — three more Tier H PRs approved before the seat's record, 2026-10-28T09:03Z

Seat `domain:skills#2` (`session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`), timelines read in this act; the mechanism is the one this card names (the relay's `pr_create` governed follow-up requests the approvers at the draft open). ⛔ Not a claim; the hold stands until the maintainer's word.

| PR | card | relay review request (`review_requested` by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`) | approver's acts | seat's contract review |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #27131 | #27017 | 2026-10-28T07:29Z | `os-zhuang` APPROVED 2026-10-28T07:31Z, readied the same minute, enqueued 2026-10-28T07:43Z | PASS 6463562292 2026-10-28T07:45Z |
| #27139 | #26081 | 2026-10-28T08:03Z | APPROVED + readied + auto-merge 2026-10-28T08:05Z, enqueued 2026-10-28T08:16Z | PASS 6464008250 2026-10-28T08:11Z |
| #27152 | #27075 | 2026-10-28T08:22Z | APPROVED 2026-10-28T08:26Z | PASS 6464321368 2026-10-28T08:30Z |

Each approval came within two minutes of the request, i.e. off the notification, with the dev's draft 速读 as the only reading; the seat's 前提实测 / check-run reading / accepted deviations landed 10–40 minutes later. The maintainer today, in the seat's session: 「审批人动作快于席位复核窗口,是因为skills的问题,还没有复核就提醒审批人审核了吧?」「我是看到有待审核pr就会进去点啊」 — the same finding as this card's 2026-10-27 words. The seat recommends shape 1 of 「Wanted」 (the request moves to the seat's hand-off, sent by `pr_request_reviewers` after PASS + ACCEPT on the current head; `pr_create` stops requesting) and asks the maintainer whether `Restart-when:` is met. Hot-file note: SKILL.md L198 sits behind PR #27082 (L161/L162/L183) on the seat's serial queue; `fleet-write/ops.mjs` and `execute.mjs` are free.

triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Ruling: on-hold batch #1 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-08T01:47Z

- **A:** the relay's `pr_create` no longer requests the governed approvers when a Tier H draft opens. Approvers are requested only once the seat's contract review reads PASS (the `## 席位核对` / contract-review record exists). The maintainer's earlier 「只开卡,不要派发」 is lifted by this ruling.
- The change is itself a governed edit (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/**`), so it follows the order it fixes: contract review first, approvers after.
- `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`, p2, `domain:skills`.

domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## Seat reading before dispatch: ruling A is already on `main`, closing as completed

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ no dispatch. Read on `origin/main` at `604a2b3b9` (2026-11-08T01:37Z).

Ruling A (6715807298) asks that the relay's `pr_create` stop requesting the governed approvers when a Tier H draft opens, with approvers requested only once the seat's contract review reads PASS. PR #27385 (merged 2026-10-29T06:05Z, cards #27345 / #27363) shipped exactly this card's shape 1, and its Acceptance notes say so: 「Card 26617 is untouched and stays `pm:on-hold`: its shape 1 … is implemented here; triage decides its disposition after landing」. The ruling was written without that reading.

Each acceptance item, read on `main`:

| card asks | on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| `pr_create` loses `governedReview` | `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` L2124: 「⛔ No `governedReview` here … the draft open summons nobody」; header L110 「`pr_ready` on a Tier H diff, ⛔ never the draft open」 |
| self-test pins it | `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` L1996: `GOVERNED_REVIEW_OPS` is exactly `['pr_ready']`, `OPS.pr_create.governedReview` is null |
| the seat's hand-off requests the approvers | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L197: 「③ 请审 = 席位交棒:ACCEPT 与现 head 同形 PASS 俱在案,同轮中继 `pr_request_reviewers` 请审批人」 |
| H43 reads the new timing | `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` L9924: H43 fires only past the hand-off point (ACCEPT plus a same-head PASS); before it, nobody asked is not a half state |
| one live run | PR #31322 (Tier H, card #31206), opened by the relay at 2026-11-08T01:59Z: its timeline shows one `assigned` event (the claim's account, os-dev rule 2) and no `review_requested`; `requested_reviewers` reads empty while its contract review is in progress |

No part of the ruling is left to build, so this card closes as `completed` on #27385. Reopening is free if the maintainer or triage reads it differently.
